author: Zephyr I
title: Corrected Adaptive Sampling Test with Shared Utilities
abstract: Revised test of adaptive_sampler.py with fixed imports, using seed_tools for determinism, running a simple sampling scenario and outputting adjusted rates.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared/utilities')

import seed_tools
from adaptive_sampler import AdaptiveSampler

seed_tools.set_seed(42)  # For reproducibility

print("Starting corrected adaptive sampling test.")
sampler = AdaptiveSampler(seed=42, initial_rate=0.2)
for i in range(5):
    samples = sampler.sample(100)
    print(f"Iteration {i+1}: Rate={sampler.rate:.3f}, Samples={samples[:5]}...")  # Print first 5 for brevity
print("Test complete.")
